scope_rule: Functional behavior only. Pixel-perfect color/size parity is excluded; controls must remain usable and behaviorally equivalent.
completion_rule: PASS only when every requirement is verified, no requirement is UNTESTED, no known functional gap remains, metadata architecture audit has zero violations, and required build/runtime checks are green.

requirements.requirement: Flow list is the landing view for existing flows.
New Flow opens flow-type creation.
Existing flow opens in editable GPT Builder from its list action.
Saved flow reopens with the same editable step structure, not collapsed hidden business logic.
Screen Flow can be created and edited.
Record-Triggered Flow can be created and edited.
Schedule-Triggered Flow can be created and edited.
Platform Event-Triggered Flow can be created and edited.
Autolaunched Flow can be created and edited.
Record-triggered Start requires an object and supports created/updated/created-or-updated/deleted semantics.
Record-triggered entry conditions use metadata fields and supported operators.
Schedule Start persists schedule settings and optional object/conditions.
Platform Event Start selects an event from platform event metadata.
Changing Start context refreshes downstream automatic resources.
$Record exists whenever the flow has a current record context.
$Record__Prior exists where prior-record context is supported.
Record fields are discoverable from metadata under $Record.
Platform Event $Record fields are generated from the selected event field_schema.
Changing the selected Platform Event refreshes $Record child fields.
Relationship/reference fields expose permitted related fields where traversal is supported.
Resource pickers expose compatible automatic, variable, formula, constant, choice, record and step-output resources.
Resource pickers preserve data types and reject incompatible resource types.
Resource search finds nested record/event fields, not only top-level resources.
Deleted/disabled fields are not offered as valid new bindings.
Saved bindings reopen to the same resource path.
Assignment is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Decision is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Loop is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Get Records is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Create Records is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Update Records is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Delete Records is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Collection Filter is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Collection Sort is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Transform is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Wait variants are fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Subflow is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Screen is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Action is fully configurable, saveable and editable.
Custom Error/Stop paths remain editable and executable where supported.
Rollback Records remains available only where supported and works transactionally.
Decision supports ordered outcomes plus Default.
Decision conditions can choose nested $Record and event fields.
Decision operators are type-compatible.
Decision resource-vs-resource comparison filters compatible resources.
Decision branch edits persist through save/reopen.
Auto-layout add buttons insert at the intended position/path.
Decision branches render and remain independently editable.
Groups collapse/expand without losing members or wiring.
Free-form mode supports moving and connecting supported nodes without corrupting flow metadata.
Switching layout modes either preserves semantics or blocks with a clear recoverable error.
Undo/redo restores functional flow state.
Canvas leaves no functional dead zone that prevents reaching or editing nodes.
Toolbar controls remain individually operable without overlap or clipped hit targets.
Save creates or updates a valid editable draft.
Save As New Version preserves prior versions and the editable graph.
Save As New Flow creates an independent editable flow.
Reopen after save preserves Start, resources, nodes, branches, properties and layout semantics.
Activation only succeeds for a valid saved version.
Deactivate preserves the editable definition.
Run executes the most recent saved version with correct inputs/context.
Debug executes with inspectable inputs/results and supported wait behavior.
Tests support saved scenarios and assertions where applicable.
Rollback mode prevents committed record changes where promised.
Skip-start options behave only where supported.
Runtime failures surface actionable errors without corrupting the saved definition.
Builder contains no business-specific object/action/field mappings.
Business behavior is represented as editable metadata/flow steps, not hidden CALL_FUNCTION logic.
Generic runtime primitives may execute metadata but must not encode app-specific business behavior.
Provider secrets remain masked and are referenced through secure provider metadata.
All labels, fields, actions, visibility and bindings are resolved from metadata where business-specific.
Missing metadata produces a clear configuration error instead of silently inventing fields or behavior.
Wrong resource type cannot be silently accepted into an incompatible input.
A removed/renamed field does not resolve to an unrelated field.
Malformed/incomplete flow cannot be activated as valid.
A backend/runtime error does not get reported as a successful execution.
Every discovered functional defect gets a permanent regression test before closure.
Critical behavior tests are mutation-checked: deliberate breakage must make the relevant test fail.
Final verification is performed fresh against current code, not by trusting earlier audit output.
No requirement may be counted toward completion while marked UNTESTED.

coverage: all supported element families exposed in correct flow contexts

phase4.goal: Negative tests and permanent regression coverage; fix every failure before progression.
